title: M1 L2 — My Hero, Language Focus 1, Birthday (p.40–42)
readingPassages: p.40 — Goal Activity: ヒーローを紹介しよう！
Make a "My Hero" poster and present it.
Example — Li Ming:
Job: firefighter / In: China
1. He is my uncle. He can run fast.
2. He can speak many languages.
3. He is kind and brave. I love his smile.
Let's Talk:
A: Can he speak Japanese?
B: Yes, he can. He can speak Chinese, English, and Japanese.
p.41 — Language Focus 1:
Word order — English: Subject → Verb → Object (I have a cat).
Affirmative: I am Tanaka Hana. / I like English.
Negative: I am not a baseball fan. / I do not play soccer.
Questions: Are you a baseball fan? — Yes, I am. / No, I am not.
Do you play soccer? — Yes, I do. / No, I do not.
Nouns — countable (a cat → cats) and uncountable (water, music).
Plural: book→books, cherry→cherries, foot→feet, child→children.
p.42 — Words & Sounds 2: 誕生日はいつ？
When is your birthday?
My birthday is July 14.
Months: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December
Dates: first, second, third … fourteenth … twentieth, twenty-first … thirty-first
